Name: Hiding Bandages
Description: You fling out the ribbon toward a willing creature within reach, having it latch onto their back and have their body be covered in red laces which hide away their impurities and wounds. You may choose to nullify the effects of one of the Conditions the target is suffering from for the spell’s duration.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you may target an additional creature within reach for each level above 2nd. You may also choose an additional Condition to nullify per second spell slot spent above 4th, such as 4th, 6th and 8th level spell slots.
